subject: gk
question: IR-8 is a dwarf variety of which crop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **IR-8** is a high-yielding dwarf variety of rice developed by the International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) in the Philippines in 1966.
 
• It is referred to as the "Miracle Rice" for its ability to significantly increase rice production and address food shortages in developing nations.
 
• IR-8 was developed through crossbreeding techniques using rice varieties from Indonesia and China.
 
• This variety is characterized by its short stature, which prevents lodging (falling over) during heavy rains or strong winds, a common problem for traditional tall rice varieties.
 
• IR-8 played a crucial role in the Green Revolution, particularly in Asia, helping many countries achieve self-sufficiency in rice production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Rice Research Institute (IRRI)**

 
 
• IRRI, based in Los Baños, Philippines, is the world's premier research organization dedicated to rice science.
 
• Founded in 1960, IRRI focuses on improving rice production and ensuring global food security.
 
• It collaborates with governments, agricultural organizations, and farmers to develop sustainable rice varieties and farming practices.
 
 
 
• **Green Revolution**
 
 
• The Green Revolution refers to a period of agricultural transformation during the mid-20th century, aimed at increasing food production worldwide.
 
• It involved the development of high-yielding crop varieties, including IR-8, along with the use of chemical fertilizers and advanced irrigation techniques.
 
• The Green Revolution helped countries like India and the Philippines overcome chronic food shortages.
 
 
 
• **Lodging in Crops**
 
 
• Lodging occurs when crop plants fall over due to heavy rains, strong winds, or their own weight.
 
• Dwarf varieties like IR-8 minimize lodging due to their shorter and sturdier stems.
 
• This feature is critical for ensuring consistent yields in regions prone to adverse weather conditions.
 
 
 
• **Impact of IR-8**
 
 
• IR-8 had a transformational impact on rice production in Asia, particularly in countries like India, Indonesia, and the Philippines.
 
• Its high yield potential helped reduce hunger and malnutrition in regions heavily reliant on rice as a staple food.
 
• It paved the way for further research and development of improved rice varieties worldwide.
